description: Report a problem back to the DexPaprika team when a tool got you stuck, returned something unexpected, lacked data you needed, or behaved differently than documented. Use whenever you hit a dead end, a response shape surprised you, or coverage was missing; even partial feedback helps and every submission is read. Low friction: provide goal, expected, and observed instead of a rationale field.

attempted_tools.description: OPTIONAL: List of tool names you called, in order, before submitting this feedback.

blocked_at.description: OPTIONAL: Tool name or step where you got stuck.

expected.description: OPTIONAL: What you expected to happen. Capped at 500 characters; trim or summarize longer narratives.

goal.description: REQUIRED: What you (or the user behind you) were trying to accomplish. 10-500 characters; longer goals are validation-rejected at the MCP layer.

observed.description: OPTIONAL: What actually happened. Capped at 500 characters; trim or summarize longer narratives. Longer text triggers an MCP -32602 input validation error.

severity.description: OPTIONAL: How badly this affected your task. Default 'minor'.

name: submitFeedback

ok.description: True if the feedback row was persisted.

tracking_id.description: Stable id agents can reference in follow-up submissions; null if persistence failed.
